revision_reason: V66 records a new fail-closed source blocker discovered while re-entering the V65 real-FusedFabric source-path test. The retained FusedFabric coordinator currently accepts a caller-supplied proof dictionary whose physical-cohort predicates are booleans. The newly landed source-path integration fixture explicitly synthesizes that proof and sets every physical predicate true while using deterministic fake producer PIDs. This is valid as a source-path composition fixture only, but it demonstrates that the coordinator has no source-level provenance boundary separating a genuinely observed physical cohort witness from a caller-forged proof dictionary. Therefore neither the test nor this source shape can promote physical GRID10 evidence.

observed_coordinator_behavior: atomic_fused_cohort_commit requires proof booleans all_alive_at_barrier, distinct_os_pids == 10, parent_child_pid_binding, same_snapshot_identity, all_transactions_open_at_barrier, all_hold_readonly_s1_fd_at_barrier, writer_free_identity_stable and process_intervals_overlap_release
the coordinator consumes ready_by_node marker values from the same caller-supplied proof dictionary for PID, read-receipt and snapshot cross-checks
no proof schema, proof digest, source-generator identity, nonforgeable in-process witness capability, or direct procfs/held-transaction attestation is validated by atomic_fused_cohort_commit itself
observed_test_behavior: _fixture creates deterministic packets with producer_pid 9001..9010 rather than deriving the proof from spawn_held_cohort
the positive test is intentionally named/source-scoped around real FusedFabric persistence, but the physical proof supplied to that path is synthetic

new_blocker.claim: At source/API level, possession of correctly shaped proof data is currently treated as equivalent to observation of the physical cohort proof. A caller can construct the same booleans/markers without having performed the underlying procfs/transaction/barrier observations.
new_blocker.counterhypothesis: The proof object is intended to be an internal trusted value produced only by spawn_held_cohort, so raw-dictionary forgery is outside the intended call contract.
new_blocker.adjudication: The counterhypothesis is not sufficient for Clay evidence authority because the function signature accepts an ordinary dict, source contains no trusted-constructor/provenance check, and the current integration test itself exercises the supposedly physical gate with a synthetic dict. Treat the physical proof as SOURCE_UNTRUSTED until a source-enforced provenance boundary exists.
new_blocker.falsifier: Show an exact-current source guard that makes a synthetic proof dictionary incapable of entering atomic_fused_cohort_commit while preserving a separately explicit source-fixture-only composition path.

design_direction.preferred: Split source-fixture composition from physical evidence admission. The physical coordinator should accept a typed/opaque PhysicalCohortWitness minted by the physical observation path and reject raw or explicitly synthetic proof dictionaries. Source-only integration may use a distinct helper/API whose receipt is structurally incapable of claiming physical_grid10_runtime_credit.
minimum_gate: introduce explicit proof kind/provenance and fail closed on SYNTHETIC_SOURCE_FIXTURE at the physical commit boundary
bind witness identity to exact node/PID/read-receipt/snapshot/barrier observations generated by the retained physical observation path
add a strict regression showing a synthetically asserted all-true proof cannot mutate FusedFabric physical-cohort state
preserve a separate deterministic source-composition test for resealed-envelope persistence/replay without physical-evidence semantics
do not create a second cohort authority or second truth/effect path
